L32: Mind Quest Incorporated, 2017 - 400 páginas
L33: In this insightful memoir, Adrian Newey, renowned as one of Formula 1's most successful and innovative designers, takes readers on a journey through his illustrious career. The book delves into his design philosophies, the challenges faced in creating championship-winning cars, and the intricacies of aerodynamics and engineering that define modern F1 vehicles. Newey also shares personal anecdotes, offering a glimpse into his life both on and off the racetrack.
L34: How to Build a Car is not just a technical manual but a compelling narrative that combines passion, precision, and the pursuit of excellence in the world of motorsport.

L16: # Out of the Crisis, reissue
L17: 【7†W. Edwards Deming†www.google.com】MIT Press, Oct 16, 2018 - 【8†Business & Economics†www.google.com】 - 448 pages The classic and deeply influential work on business management, leadership, problem solving, and quality control—based on Denning’s famous 14 Points for Management.
L18: Now reissued for the managers and leaders of today!
L19: Translated into 12 languages and continuously in print since its original publication in 1982, this highly influential framework presents the foundations for a completely transformational way to lead and manage people, processes, and resources.
L20: According to Deming, American company management’s failure to plan for the future brings about loss of market, which brings about loss of jobs. Management must be judged not only by the quarterly dividend, but by innovative plans to:
L21: • Stay in business
L22: • Protect investment
L23: • Ensure future dividends
L24: • Provide more jobs through improved product and service
L25: In simple, direct language, Deming explains the principles of management transformation and how to apply them. This edition includes a foreword by Deming’s grandson, Kevin Edwards Cahill, and Kelly Allan, business consultant and Deming expert. [Input]
